visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in an airplane cabin where a woman dressed as a flight attendant sits on a jump seat, appearing worried while touching her face. A green title overlay is visible at the top. (2) A man in a white shirt enters the frame, smiling and holding a green beauty blender and a bottle of mineral water. The background shows the airplane's interior wall and equipment. (3) A close-up of the woman's face follows as she looks at herself in a mirror, with variety-style text appearing near her face to describe makeup issues. (4) The scene shifts to hands pouring water from a plastic bottle into a small cup containing the green beauty blender, followed by a shot of hands squeezing the blender within a white tissue. (5) The flight attendant is shown using the damp beauty blender to dab her face gently with a smile, while decorative text animations appear around her. (6) The woman is then seen standing confidently in the airplane aisle between seats, smiling broadly at the camera. (7) Final sequence shows a montage of the characters with credit text overlays, ending with the EVA AIR logo on a black background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a bright, ascending synthesizer chime followed immediately by a cheerful, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM. (2) A female voice enters with a distressed, high-arousal tone, expressing concern about her makeup. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) A friendly male voice interrupts with a confident, soothing tone, offering a solution while the BGM provides a consistent rhythmic pulse. (4) A transient liquid pouring sound effect is heard as the male narrator begins a technical explanation in a clear, professional broadcast style. (5) Soft, rhythmic dabbing sound effects (thuds) are synchronized with the visual action of using the beauty blender. (6) The male narrator's voice becomes more enthusiastic and positive as he describes the final makeup effect. (7) The BGM swells slightly in volume during the concluding appreciative remark from the male speaker. (8) The audio ends with a clean fade-out of the upbeat electronic music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demo -> Result -> Branding
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional beauty tutorial set within an EVA AIR cabin. It uses a common beauty problem (makeup wearing off during a flight) to introduce a 'life hack' involving a damp beauty blender. The strategic intent is to associate the airline brand with helpful, high-quality lifestyle content and to showcase the professional yet approachable image of its flight attendants.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is heavily branded with the EVA AIR logo, features flight attendants in uniform, and is set within an EVA AIR aircraft.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines professional service imagery with relatable lifestyle content. The high production value and use of a known makeup expert (Kai-mi) suggest a targeted marketing campaign.
